name: opentelemetry
description: Connects the site's traces to any OpenTelemetry (OTLP/HTTP) backend, such as Grafana Cloud or Honeycomb, through the OpenTelemetry provider plugin in the same package (observability-opentelemetry). Ships the know-how and a secure key card: the person enters the OTLP endpoint, an optional username or instance ID, and the token; the host saves it to your project, and you choose which sites use it. No vendor code here; the provider plugin exports the traces.
author: Tovu

tovu.summary: Sends your site's traces to Grafana Cloud, Honeycomb or any OpenTelemetry backend.

credentialCards.intro: Send this site's traces to an OpenTelemetry (OTLP/HTTP) backend.

credentialCards.keyHint: Grafana Cloud: your stack → OpenTelemetry → Configure shows the endpoint, the instance ID (username) and creates a token. Honeycomb: endpoint https://api.honeycomb.io and Extra headers x-honeycomb-team=<ingest API key>.
